step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram split by a dashed line depicts a Write intensive architecture on the left and a Read intensive architecture on the right. On the Write side, API Gateway and Lambda process write requests and push events into a Kinesis Data Stream. Legacy applications drop files into an S3 bucket which feeds into an EMR cluster running Apache Spark. EMR processes data and pushes outputs to a Read Kinesis Data Stream across the boundary. On the Read side, Kinesis feeds DynamoDB, which streams data to Elasticsearch (OpenSearch). Athena queries historical data from a bottom S3 Data Lake bucket and structured data in DynamoDB. Read APIs are served via a dedicated API Gateway and Lambda pair.
